title: Larry Kochard – From Endowment Professor to OCIO Chief at Makena Capital (Capital Allocators, EP.250)

reader_summary.headline: Larry Kochard is the CIO at Makena Capital Management.
reader_summary.overview: Larry Kochard is the CIO at Makena Capital Management, a $20 billion OCIO formed by senior executives from the Stanford Management Company in 2005. Larry joined Makena in 2018, following a storied career serving as CEO and CIO of University of Virginia Investment Management Company. He was an early guest on Capital Allocators discussing his path, and that conversation is replayed in the feed.

key_points.text: Larry joined Makena in 2018, following a storied career serving as CEO and CIO of University of Virginia Investment Management Company.
This time around we discuss Larry's transition to Makena, the differences between leading endowments and an OCIO.
We then dive into different investment opportunities across crossover funds, hedge funds, co-investments, REITs, venture capital, emerging markets, real assets, and crypto.
